The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Sugarcane from Maharashtra, Kerala sweetens Hyderabad’s summer
Supreme Court refuses to entertain plea over renaming Navi Mumbai International Airport
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Bench said it was not inclined to entertain the plea challenging a November 2025 order of the Bombay High Court, which had dismissed the petition.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Tempo-truck collision in Maharashtra’s Palghar: FIR against both drivers for traffic violations
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Heavy traffic on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Highway, coupled with the tempo driver taking a wrong-side shortcut in violation of traffic rules, led to the fatal crash

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Citizens continue protests against proposed felling of 45,000 mangrove trees in Mumbai for Coastal Road project
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Citizen volunteer-led group continue to protest and question the felling of 45,000 mangroves for the second phase of the Mumbai Coastal Road project which aims to connect suburbs Versova and Bhayandar

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra FDA seizes methanol from Bhiwandi firm after Pune liquor deaths
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The chemical was supplied to bootleggers who allegedly made the liquor that killed 16 people in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad
